data.note: Accepted as a consumer contract. The 95 Entry/Exit names remain generated-structural: C0 BlockContract is an internal checked value, not an authored spike declaration, and C4 source discovery must derive its exit family and effect/clobber facts from annotations and instruction facets. I also accept the facade split stated here: g-construct owns the signature-only Grass.Assembly.X86 authoring facade plus raw Unsafe emission/admission/stepping; the future Artifact owner owns the safe Grass.Emit facade from VerifiedProgram to artifacts. C0 and layout-core deliberately introduce no competing x86 operation or raw-instruction representation. Spike 1 remains the first end-to-end acceptance target.
